scene: Atop the roof, three strange transit links wait across the city skyline.
picture: Pixel art flat side view. Along the rooftop sky-deck, arranged left to right: a brass pulley book cart lift with an open gate, the tall Latino player standing at centre by the red ladder top, an idling purple night bus at a ramp stop, and a striped ferris wheel gondola hanging open.
shown: a brass book cart lift with an open gate on the far left
a purple night bus idling at a rooftop ramp stop on the right
